title: 标普 500：AI 浪潮中的市值、基本面与估值
title_en: S&P 500: Market Value, Fundamentals and Valuation in the AI Wave
subtitle: 2023 年 5 月至 2026 年 10 月 · 研究札记
author: Taiyang Feng (Sunny)
summary: AI 相关公司的市值增长 191.0%，公司营收增长 70.6%，GAAP 净利润增长 244.0%；最新等权与市值加权营收同比为 28.3% 和 40.6%。加权扩展版修订历史营收，区分总量、等权、市值加权和对数分解口径，保留分类、盈利质量及因果解释的边界。
summary_en: AI-related companies' market value rose 191.0%, company revenue 70.6% and GAAP net income 244.0%. Latest equal-weighted and market-cap-weighted revenue growth is 28.3% and 40.6%. The weighting extension revises historical revenue and distinguishes aggregate, equal-weighted, market-cap-weighted and logarithmic-decomposition measures, with explicit classification, earnings-quality and causal-inference boundaries.
articleBody:
## 研究摘要：基本面增长、定价与再投资

AI 组市值增长 191.0%，公司营收增长 70.6%。营收确有领先增长，但市值扩张明显更快。动态成分与股数变化也影响总量，不能把差距全部归为估值。

GAAP 净利润增长 244.0%，PE 从 33.8 降到 28.6 倍；P/S 则从 5.0 升到 8.5 倍。利润率提升与非经营损益使两种估值信号分化。

最新 41 家 AI 公司占公司数 8.2%、市值 47.4%；前五家公司占 AI 市值 63.9%。过去一年上涨公司占比为 AI 61.0%、剩余 62.9%：总量领先不代表组内普涨。

资本开支 / 营收由 11.0% 升至 18.8%；FCF 率由 18.1% 的期内高点回落至 15.5%。这是再投资强度与现金兑现之间的张力，还不能判定投资回报好坏。

| 基准 → 最新 | AI 相关 | 标普整体 | 剩余公司 |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 市值变化 | +191.0% | +91.4% | +46.2% |
| TTM 营收变化 | +70.6% | +23.1% | +15.1% |
| TTM GAAP 净利润变化 | +244.0% | +74.7% | +28.4% |
| 累计总收益 | +185.7% | +96.3% | +54.2% |
| 整体 PE | 33.8 → 28.6 | 23.3 → 25.5 | 20.4 → 23.1 |
| 非金融 P/S | 5.0 → 8.5 | 2.3 → 3.6 | 1.7 → 2.2 |
| 资本开支 / 营收 | 11.0% → 18.8% | 5.9% → 8.6% | 4.8% → 5.5% |
| FCF / 营收 | 12.5% → 15.5% | 8.7% → 10.3% | 7.9% → 8.8% |

比率使用匹配样本；公司营收不等于 AI 业务收入；收益权重不同。

## 市值与基本面：增长来自哪里

事实：AI 营收 +70.6%，剩余 +15.1%；AI 市值 +191.0%，GAAP 利润 +244.0%。

解释：涨幅具有已实现盈利的会计支持，但 GAAP 利润含投资重估；动态成分总量也包含组成变化，不能直接识别 AI 因果贡献。

来源：用户 CRSP / Compustat、Massive、Yahoo Finance、SEC｜基准 2023-04-28 = 100；数据截至 2026-10-09，虚线为 10 月快照。

## 份额与广度：集中度不等于普涨

事实：AI 市值份额 31.2% → 47.4%，营收份额 14.4% → 20.0%，利润份额 21.5% → 42.3%。上涨广度 AI 61.0%、剩余 62.9%。

解释：市场价值更加集中于主题公司；AI 前五大占组内市值 63.9%。总量增长不等于多数公司的增长，公司贡献仍需进一步拆解。

来源：用户 CRSP / Compustat、Massive、Yahoo Finance、SEC｜基准 2023-04-28 = 100；数据截至 2026-10-09，虚线为 10 月快照。

## 估值与增长：P/E 与 P/S 给出不同信号

事实：AI PE 33.8 → 28.6 倍，P/S 5.0 → 8.5 倍；配对营收同比 AI 25.3%、剩余 8.8%。

解释：市值相对营收与 GAAP 利润的定价可能分化，不能据此判定现在便宜。Alphabet Q2 投资收益使净利润增加 771 亿美元。

来源：用户 CRSP / Compustat、Massive、Yahoo Finance、SEC｜基准 2023-04-28 = 100；数据截至 2026-10-09，虚线为 10 月快照。

## 利润与现金：扩张需要多少再投资

事实：AI 净利率 14.8% → 29.9%，资本开支率 11.0% → 18.8%；FCF 率期内高点 18.1%、最新 15.5%，初始 12.5%。

解释：会计盈利与现金生成可能分化；固定样本和公司层面检验前，不能把 FCF 率的变化全部归因于 AI 资本开支。

来源：用户 CRSP / Compustat、Massive、Yahoo Finance、SEC｜基准 2023-04-28 = 100；数据截至 2026-10-09，虚线为 10 月快照。

## 营收增长口径 总量 等权与市值加权

事实：最新等权 / 市值加权营收同比：AI 28.3% / 40.6%，整体 12.7% / 26.8%，剩余 11.2% / 14.2%；有效公司 41 / 489 / 448 家。

口径：图 10 为配对营收金额的同比；图 17、18 为同一样本的个股同比均值。市值权重取上月末，缺失后归一化，不缩尾；并购及低基数也影响结果。

来源：用户 CRSP / Compustat、Massive、Yahoo Finance、SEC｜基准 2023-04-28 = 100；数据截至 2026-10-09，虚线为 10 月快照。

## 结论与复查修订

自 2023 年 4 月基准以来，主分类 AI 公司市值增长 191.0%，公司全部营收增长 70.6%，GAAP 净利润增长 244.0%。市值份额由 31.2% 升至 47.4%，利润份额由 21.5% 升至 42.3%。营收总量由 2.277 万亿升至 3.885 万亿美元；营收增长率按公司收入金额汇总，并非个股增速的简单平均。

对数恒等式中，盈利项为 123.6 个对数点，估值项为 -16.7 个对数点。它们不能直接称为累计简单收益的百分点贡献。股数、成分与权重变化进入其余项，这一会计分解也不能证明 AI 的因果贡献。PE 由 33.8 降至 28.6 倍，是相对 GAAP 盈利的定价结果，不能单独用来否定泡沫或证明估值合理。

盈利质量与现金兑现仍需谨慎解释。仅剔除 Alphabet 单季 771 亿美元的股权投资收益，最新 AI PE 约为 30.7 倍；这不是完整经营利润调整。P/S 由 5.0 升至 8.5 倍，净利率由 14.8% 升至 29.9%，而 FCF 率由 12.5% 变为 15.5%；资本开支率最新为 18.8%。这些数值应结合相同公司的经营盈利与现金流解释。

前五大公司占组内市值 63.9%，上涨公司占比 AI 61.0%、其余 62.9%。我们保留主题具有基本面支撑的判断，同时对估值合理性保持克制。当前名单是选定的参考范围，不能声称覆盖所有 AI 敞口。去头部、经营利润调整和投资回报分析仍是后续验证。

本页延续作者原有观点，并按完整复查结果更新数据、对数单位和证据边界。原始作者版本独立保存在 source_documents。加权检查另修正 CPT、CHD、AXON、FIX 的历史营收，相关图已重算；来源与缺口见随附扩展说明。

## 方法、分类对照与必要边界

广义 AI + 历史退出公司：41 家，市值份额 47.4%，营收份额 20.0%，累计研究组合收益 185.7%。

固定 41 家广义 AI：41 家，市值份额 47.4%，营收份额 20.0%，累计研究组合收益 186.8%。

固定 29 家直接 AI：29 家，市值份额 46.0%，营收份额 18.5%，累计研究组合收益 190.8%。

研究期为 2023 年 5 月至 2026-10-09，基准 2023-04-28，完整月末至 2026-09。历史成分随生效事件变化；股份类别归并到公司。股数与成分变化会影响市值及基本面总量。

主分类为选定的 41 家参考，加 ANSS、JNPR、EPAM、TTD、DXC、DAY/CDAY、PAYC 七家历史退出补充；补充从商业化证据生效后且实际在指数内时使用。参考名单为回顾性标签。VRT、MRVL 等名单外公司也有 AI 敞口，当前纳入剩余组；本研究不是所有 AI 公司的完整行业统计。

市值为上市普通股总额，非官方自由流通市值。PE 包含亏损及 GAAP 非经营损益；P/S、净利率、资本开支率、FCF 率为非金融匹配样本。图 16 在紧凑版展示最新累计对数分解；独立图保留完整月度四面板曲线。

CRSP 市场历史至 2026-04-30，之后 Massive。申报日期不明盘中时点时次日可用；更早公告经原件核实后桥接。已披露新财期却无法恢复可比 TTM 的旧值留空。DLR 资本开支为现金房地产开发改良，排除资产收购；分拆历史报表含原母公司分摊，整体曲线不等于同公司有机增长。

最新 AI 营收 / 净利润可得市值覆盖 100.0% / 100.0%，整体 99.8% / 99.8%。AI 资本开支率 / FCF 率覆盖 100.0% / 100.0%。覆盖率表示非缺失，不表示新鲜度；逐公司财务期末、最新披露期与未恢复项目另附工作簿及审计文件。

AI / 剩余为上市普通股市值加权月度再平衡组合，整体为官方标普总收益指数；权重不同、未计交易成本。固定公司同比使用当期成员的前后 TTM 配对。历史盈利预期按要求排除。

## 盈利质量、来源与后续验证

Alphabet 2026 Q2 原始公告披露，股权证券净收益使净利润增加 771 亿美元。仅机械剔除这一项，AI 组最新 PE 约由 28.6 升至 30.7 倍；这只是一项敏感性示意，不是完整经营性利润调整。不能把 GAAP 净利润曲线直接当作 AI 核心经营盈利曲线。

现有图表支持“主题公司的营收、利润和市场价值同时增长，并伴随更高再投资强度”。它们尚不能回答：增长有多少来自 AI 业务；去除头部公司后是否仍成立；投入的最终现金回报是否达到市场要求。

优先扩展三项验证：按公司分解营收、利润及收益贡献，检验头部集中；补充经营利润与非经营损益调整；将直接 AI、电力、设备分层，配对资本开支、经营现金流和回报。以上是后续研究方向，不代表本版已完成。

articleBody_en:
## Research Summary: Fundamentals, Pricing and Reinvestment

AI market value grew 191.0%, while company revenue grew 70.6%. Revenue outperformed, but market value expanded much faster. Changing constituents and share counts also affect the aggregates; the gap cannot be attributed entirely to valuation.

GAAP net income grew 244.0%, and P/E fell from 33.8 to 28.6 times; P/S rose from 5.0 to 8.5 times. Higher profit margins and non-operating gains and losses cause the two valuation signals to diverge.

The latest 41 AI companies represent 8.2% of companies and 47.4% of market value; the top five account for 63.9% of AI market value. The share of companies advancing over the past year is 61.0% for AI and 62.9% for the remainder: aggregate outperformance does not imply broad gains within the group.

Capex / revenue rose from 11.0% to 18.8%; the FCF margin fell from its period peak of 18.1% to 15.5%. This reflects tension between reinvestment intensity and cash realization; it does not yet establish whether investment returns are good or poor.

| Base to latest | AI-related | S&P 500 | Remaining |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Market value change | +191.0% | +91.4% | +46.2% |
| TTM revenue change | +70.6% | +23.1% | +15.1% |
| TTM GAAP income change | +244.0% | +74.7% | +28.4% |
| Cumulative total return | +185.7% | +96.3% | +54.2% |
| Aggregate P/E | 33.8 → 28.6 | 23.3 → 25.5 | 20.4 → 23.1 |
| Non-financial P/S | 5.0 → 8.5 | 2.3 → 3.6 | 1.7 → 2.2 |
| Capex / revenue | 11.0% → 18.8% | 5.9% → 8.6% | 4.8% → 5.5% |
| FCF / revenue | 12.5% → 15.5% | 8.7% → 10.3% | 7.9% → 8.8% |

Ratios use matched samples; company revenue is not AI business revenue; return weights differ.

## Market Value and Fundamentals: Sources of Growth

Facts: AI revenue +70.6%, remaining companies +15.1%; AI market value +191.0%, GAAP net income +244.0%.

Interpretation: The gains have accounting support from realized earnings, but GAAP earnings include investment revaluations. Changing-constituent aggregates also reflect composition effects and cannot directly identify AI's causal contribution.

Sources: User-provided CRSP / Compustat, Massive, Yahoo Finance and SEC | Base: 2023-04-28 = 100; data through 2026-10-09; dashed lines denote the October snapshot.

## Shares and Breadth: Concentration Is Not Broad Participation

Facts: AI market value share 31.2% to 47.4%, revenue share 14.4% to 20.0%, earnings share 21.5% to 42.3%. Advancing breadth: AI 61.0%, remaining companies 62.9%.

Interpretation: Market value is more concentrated in thematic companies; the five largest AI companies account for 63.9% of group market value. Aggregate growth does not mean most companies grew; company contributions still require further decomposition.

Sources: User-provided CRSP / Compustat, Massive, Yahoo Finance and SEC | Base: 2023-04-28 = 100; data through 2026-10-09; dashed lines denote the October snapshot.

## Valuation and Growth: P/E and P/S Send Different Signals

Facts: AI P/E 33.8 to 28.6 times, P/S 5.0 to 8.5 times; matched revenue growth: AI 25.3%, remaining companies 8.8%.

Interpretation: Pricing relative to revenue and GAAP earnings can diverge; this does not establish that the group is now cheap. Alphabet's Q2 investment gains increased net income by $77.1 billion.

Sources: User-provided CRSP / Compustat, Massive, Yahoo Finance and SEC | Base: 2023-04-28 = 100; data through 2026-10-09; dashed lines denote the October snapshot.

## Earnings and Cash: How Much Reinvestment Does Expansion Require?

Facts: AI net margin 14.8% to 29.9%, capex / revenue 11.0% to 18.8%; FCF margin: period peak 18.1%, latest 15.5%, initial 12.5%.

Interpretation: Accounting earnings and cash generation can diverge. Until fixed-sample and company-level tests are performed, changes in FCF margins cannot be attributed entirely to AI capital expenditure.

Sources: User-provided CRSP / Compustat, Massive, Yahoo Finance and SEC | Base: 2023-04-28 = 100; data through 2026-10-09; dashed lines denote the October snapshot.

## Revenue Growth: Aggregate, Equal-Weighted and Market Cap-Weighted

Facts: Latest equal-weighted / market cap-weighted revenue growth: AI 28.3% / 40.6%, overall 12.7% / 26.8%, remaining companies 11.2% / 14.2%; eligible companies: 41 / 489 / 448.

Method: Figure 10 measures year-on-year growth in matched revenue totals; Figures 17 and 18 average company growth rates over the same sample. Market cap weights use the prior month-end, renormalized after missing observations are excluded; no winsorization. Acquisitions and low bases also affect the results.

Sources: User-provided CRSP / Compustat, Massive, Yahoo Finance and SEC | Base: 2023-04-28 = 100; data through 2026-10-09; dashed lines denote the October snapshot.

## Conclusion and Audit Revision

Since the April 2023 base date, AI companies in the main classification have grown market value by 191.0%, total company revenue by 70.6% and GAAP net income by 244.0%. Market value share rose from 31.2% to 47.4%, and earnings share from 21.5% to 42.3%. Aggregate revenue rose from $2.277 trillion to $3.885 trillion; revenue growth is calculated from summed company revenue, not a simple average of individual growth rates.

In the logarithmic identity, the earnings term is 123.6 log points and the valuation term is -16.7 log points. These cannot be called percentage-point contributions to cumulative simple returns. Share-count, constituent and weighting changes enter the remaining term; this accounting decomposition does not establish AI's causal contribution. The decline in P/E from 33.8 to 28.6 times reflects pricing relative to GAAP earnings and cannot alone rule out a bubble or establish reasonable valuation.

Earnings quality and cash realization still require caution. Removing only Alphabet's $77.1 billion quarterly equity investment gain mechanically yields an AI P/E of about 30.7 times; this is not a full operating-earnings adjustment. P/S rose from 5.0 to 8.5 times, net margin from 14.8% to 29.9%, while FCF margin changed from 12.5% to 15.5%; latest capex / revenue is 18.8%. These figures should be interpreted alongside operating earnings and cash flows for the same companies.

The five largest companies represent 63.9% of group market value; advancing breadth is 61.0% for AI and 62.9% for the remainder. We retain the view that the theme has fundamental support, while remaining cautious about valuation. The current list is a selected reference universe and cannot claim to cover all AI exposure. Tests excluding the largest companies, operating-earnings adjustments and investment-return analysis remain future validation.

This page preserves the author's original stance while updating figures, logarithmic units and evidence boundaries based on the full review. The original author edition is archived separately in source_documents. The weighting review also corrected historical revenue for CPT, CHD, AXON and FIX, and the affected charts were recalculated; sources and gaps are detailed in the accompanying extension note.

## Methodology, Classification Comparisons and Boundaries

Broad AI plus historical exits: 41 companies, market value share 47.4%, revenue share 20.0%, cumulative research portfolio return 185.7%.

Fixed 41 broad AI companies: 41 companies, market value share 47.4%, revenue share 20.0%, cumulative research portfolio return 186.8%.

Fixed 29 direct AI companies: 29 companies, market value share 46.0%, revenue share 18.5%, cumulative research portfolio return 190.8%.

The study runs from May 2023 through 2026-10-09, with a 2023-04-28 base date and full month-ends through September 2026. Historical membership changes with effective index events; share classes are consolidated at company level. Share-count and constituent changes affect market value and fundamental aggregates.

The main classification uses 41 selected reference companies plus seven historical exits: ANSS, JNPR, EPAM, TTD, DXC, DAY/CDAY and PAYC. Exit supplements apply only after commercial evidence becomes effective and while the company is an index member. Labels are retrospective. Companies outside the list, including VRT and MRVL, also have AI exposure and are classified in the remaining group; this is not a comprehensive industry census of all AI companies.

Market value is total listed common equity, not official free-float capitalization. P/E includes losses and GAAP non-operating gains and losses; P/S, net margin, capex / revenue and FCF margin use matched non-financial samples. The compact edition shows the latest cumulative log decomposition in Figure 16; the standalone chart retains complete monthly curves in four panels.

Market history uses CRSP through 2026-04-30 and Massive thereafter. Filings become available the next day when their intraday release time is unknown; earlier announcements bridge the gap only after original-source verification. Older values are left blank when a newly disclosed period cannot be reconstructed into comparable TTM figures. DLR capex is cash real-estate development and improvements, excluding asset acquisitions. Historical carve-out statements include former-parent allocations; aggregate curves are not same-company organic growth.

Latest available market-cap coverage for AI revenue / net income is 100.0% / 100.0%, versus 99.8% / 99.8% overall. AI capex / revenue and FCF margin coverage is 100.0% / 100.0%. Coverage indicates non-missing data, not freshness; company financial period-ends, latest disclosed periods and unreconstructed items are separately documented in the accompanying workbook and audit files.

AI and remaining-company portfolios use listed-common-equity market-cap weights with monthly rebalancing; the overall benchmark is the official S&P total return index. Weights differ and transaction costs are excluded. Matched-company growth pairs earlier and later TTM figures for current constituents. Historical earnings expectations are excluded as requested.

## Earnings Quality, Sources and Further Validation

Alphabet's original Q2 2026 release states that net gains on equity securities increased net income by $77.1 billion. Mechanically removing only this item raises the latest AI P/E from about 28.6 to 30.7 times. This is a single-item sensitivity illustration, not a full operating-earnings adjustment. The GAAP net-income curve cannot be treated directly as core AI operating earnings.

The charts support simultaneous growth in thematic companies' revenue, earnings and market value, accompanied by greater reinvestment intensity. They do not yet establish how much growth came from AI business, whether the findings hold after excluding the largest companies, or whether eventual cash returns on investment meet market expectations.

Three tests take priority: decompose company contributions to revenue, earnings and returns to assess concentration; add operating-earnings and non-operating-item adjustments; and separate direct AI, power and equipment, pairing capex, operating cash flow and returns. These are future research directions, not analyses completed in this edition.
